Unmodified sources of [Scintilla](https://www.scintilla.org) and [Lexilla](https://www.scintilla.org/Lexilla.html)
(versions in VERSION, license in License.txt), the editing component Notepad++ is built on. Used by WinCode.
The only changes are the layout: the headers Swift sees moved to include/, and glue.mm wraps Lexilla's C entry points.
